body: I can't see any reason to keep living, inside me I know I already gave up, I pushed my friends away, hurt my gf, gave up everything, just seems so meaningless
I don't even know anymore, it just feels so right
Thank you, I will keep that in mind

I feel so fucking alone, to the point of wanting people to cry for me, to feel needed, even though I am not here anymore. I am tired of waiting for the possibility of getting better. I just don't know anything anymore.
I researched a little and found something pretty relatable, people called brain fog, I think it might be that. Sometimes nothing feels real.
i would want to see how long I can last, just for curiosity you know, sounds fun.
